prompt:
The graph below shows the percentage of households with a home internet connection in four regions of one country between 2000 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Households with a home internet connection in four regions, 2000-2020
visual.alt: Line graph showing the rise in the percentage of households with a home internet connection in four regions between 2000 and 2020.

key_points: The percentage rises throughout the period in all four regions; none shows a fall
Eastport stays highest and Southern Isles stays lowest throughout the period — the ranking never changes
Eastport and Northvale move almost side by side and both pass 90% by 2020
Central Plains is the region that catches up fastest: close to Southern Isles at 6% in 2000, it approaches the top two at 79% by 2020
The gap between the highest and lowest is 22 points in 2000, peaks at 52 points in 2010, and narrows to 39 points by 2020
The fastest growth in all regions is between 2000 and 2010; after 2015 the curve flattens for the top two regions
common_mistakes: Stopping at 'they all increased'; skipping the difference in speed and the gap first widening then narrowing
Confusing percentage with a number of households ('93 million households')
Reading out all five years for each region in turn instead of grouping the two regions that move similarly (Eastport and Northvale)
Inventing a reason ('the government invested in rural areas') — not shown in the graph
